parameters.content:
## 1 — SOURCES
Telegram + websites/RSS enter here.
All source-specific formatting must be normalized before entering the common pipeline.

Telegram: TG - Incoming Webhook → TG - Normalize Input
Websites: WEB - Schedule (every 15 min) → WEB - Source List (config) → WEB - Read RSS → WEB - Normalize Article

## 2 — NORMALIZE & DEDUPE
Converts every source into one common article object and prevents duplicate processing.

Website: dedupe by normalized article URL (workflow static data), newest unseen article only, optional page fetch for og:image / readable text, image download into binary image0.
Telegram: identity = channel + message_id (dedupe_key), one message per execution.
Both converge in SRC - Has Content.

## 3 — MEDIA / OCR / VISION
Processes source photos.
Text-only articles bypass this section.
Videos remain metadata-only until the video phase.

Works identically for Telegram photos and website images (binary image0).

## 4 — EDITORIAL AI
Primary: Qwen through OpenRouter.
Fallback: Hermes through OpenRouter.
Strict JSON validation is mandatory.

EDITORIAL - Publishability Filter: publish = true and importance ≥ 5.

## 5 — TEXT APPROVAL
Human editorial gate.
Nothing may continue to image generation or publishing without approval.

Source preview (photo items) → REVIEW - Text Approval (Telegram one-tap, HMAC-bound) → REVIEW - Approved?

## 6 — IMAGE GENERATION
Creates an optional original editorial visual after text approval.
AI-created assets receive the deterministic Arabic label:
صورة توضيحية

Config lives in GEN - Decide Visual Mode (model, 4:5, regeneration limit, source-strategy flag).

## 7 — VISUAL REVIEW
Human selects:
Original · Generated · Regenerate · Reject

The selected visual is the only visual allowed into Postiz.
Review form is HMAC-bound to this execution; max 2 regenerations.

## 8 — PUBLISH
Uploads the selected visual to Postiz and publishes the validated article.

Exactly one image per article. postiz_publish_started / postiz_publish_completed record the durable state.

## ERROR HANDLING
Infrastructure or validation errors end here.
No error path may silently publish content.

ERR - Notify Failed · ERR - Notify Text Rejected · ERR - Notify Generation Failed (feeds the failure review) · ERR - Notify Manual Review · ERR - Notify Visual Rejected

## LEGACY — DISABLED
Do not reconnect unless intentionally restoring an older version.

Gemini / OpenAI / old JSON parser from the pre-OpenRouter pipeline. Kept for reference only.
